rationale: BTC gave back the 75.5k floor over the weekend, wicked to 73,500 Sunday evening and now sits at 74.5k, about 1.8% under the 75,885 where the wallet trimmed Friday. The 4H and daily trends are bearish and longs are crowded (1H ratio 2.89), but the weekend flush swept the 74.4k pocket and price held the 73.75k-73.5k floor. The wallet buys back a small 15 USDT spot tranche, as planned Friday, and keeps about 31 USDT of cash for a deeper test of 73.5k.

message.text: Rebuilt a small spot tranche at 74.5k after the weekend flush to 73,500. A 1H close under 73,500 means stop buying; a 4H close above 75,609 (4H EMA20) allows a bigger add.
